events.title: "This Moment" – Contemporary Chinese Art Exhibition
events.description: HOTA Gallery presents 'This Moment', an exhibition of 35 contemporary Chinese artworks spanning installations, video, photography, painting, and sculpture, exploring themes of identity, history, and transformation through bold, experimental works. It offers a powerful snapshot of creativity, culture, and change with optional public talks and tours.

events.title: Sessions Surf Festival – Opening Night (Dope Lemon & Babe Rainbow)
events.description: The Sessions Surf Festival kicks off its Gold Coast return with a massive live music opening night at Miami Marketta, featuring a stacked line-up including headliner Dope Lemon, Babe Rainbow, Mt. Warning, and local acts, bringing together surf, film, art, and music culture.

events.title: Miami Marketta Street Food Night + Free Live Music
events.description: Miami Marketta hosts its weekly street food market featuring diverse global cuisine, accompanied by free live performances from local musicians on the Cargo Stage. It offers a relaxed, social atmosphere perfect for food lovers and those seeking community.

events.title: Rock n Country Revival Show
events.description: The Coolangatta Hotel presents a Sunday afternoon Rock n Country Revival Show, offering live music in a classic pub setting. It's an opportunity to enjoy local entertainment and a social atmosphere by the sea.

events.title: Life Drawing with Live Music
events.description: Join a curated evening of life drawing with live music at Studio 56, Miami Marketta. This hands-on workshop encourages participants of all skill levels to focus on the creative process of drawing, with all materials provided.

events.title: Seasonal Wine Tasting
events.description: Dust Temple hosts the first in a new series of intimate seasonal wine tasting events. BJ from Bacchus Wines will guide participants through a curated selection, sharing educational insights and untold stories from the bottle alongside a new bar snack menu.

events.title: BSides Goldie – Community Cybersecurity Conference
events.description: BSides Goldie is a one-day, community-led cybersecurity conference featuring 10 expert speakers at Cohort Innovation Space. This grassroots event attracts curious, technically-minded individuals for intellectually stimulating talks and discussions on security topics.

events.title: Sessions Surf Festival – Films, Panel Talks & Live Music
events.datetime: Fri 23 May – Sun 24 May (check site for specific times)
events.description: As part of the Sessions Surf Festival, the Mondrian Gold Coast hosts a cultural program featuring surf films, inspiring panel talks with world-class athletes and creatives, and live music. It offers a blend of storytelling, inspiration, and laid-back community engagement focusing on surf culture.

events.title: NextGen AI Hackathon
events.datetime: Thu 21 May, 4:00 PM – Fri 22 May, 8:00 PM
events.description: This two-day NextGen AI Hackathon at Cohort Innovation Space invites students to build and pitch an AI startup. It's a free, community-driven event designed for 'builders' of all experience levels to experiment with AI in an energetic, collaborative environment.

events.title: TableTopCon 2026 – Board Game Convention
events.location: Gold Coast Sports and Leisure Centre, Carrara
events.description: TableTopCon 2026 is a board game convention designed for tabletop gaming enthusiasts to meet, play, and connect. It's an ideal social event for curious, strategy-minded individuals in a relaxed, community-focused environment.

events.title: Musical Bingo
events.description: The Cooly Hotel hosts a weekly Musical Bingo night, offering a fun and social music-based trivia format. This recurring event is designed to spark conversation and create a lively community atmosphere among participants.

events.title: Trivia Night
events.description: The Cooly Hotel hosts its weekly Trivia Night every Monday, inviting teams to test their knowledge and enjoy a social evening. It's a recurring community event for those seeking an intellectually engaging and fun gathering.
